CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Summer-2015 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Summer-2015 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 688 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 15 benchmark sites in 1 regions spanning 1 states (survey period: June 2013 to June 2016). These surveys captured 12 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 4 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 990 cards across 37 sites, with 0.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (9 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 118 transects across 37 sites (survey period: December 2014 to February 2015), detecting active burrows in 1.7% of transects (total: 2 active burrows).
